hypotheses.description: During driver face occlusion, the still-alive DRIVER track can be matched by a rear passenger face near the predicted driver face, resetting miss count and preserving driver identity.
supporting_evidence: face missThreshold keeps old driver track alive
updateFaceTracks allows stable DRIVER rematch if small-face, distance, and total-loss gates pass
matched detection overwrites the old track box and keeps the id stable

hypotheses.description: Symmetric size continuity works against recovery after a rear passenger has taken over: the real driver face becoming larger is treated as a size jump rather than a positive driver cue.
supporting_evidence: FaceSizeContinuityLoss uses abs(log(width ratio)) plus abs(log(height ratio))
selectDriverFace rejects sizeLoss > 0.70 against the current driver reference
continuity bonus favors the already wrong driver id

hypotheses.description: Driver region is intentionally broad and there is no headrest/seat-anchor loss, so a rear passenger leaning forward can enter the driver candidate set.
supporting_evidence: driver_region is rectangular and broad in track_params.json
no headrest-specific logic was found in tracking code
